ambiguities.description: 'DARPA's standard' read as the Heilmeier Catechism per his earlier adoption

authority.basis: standing delegation for workshop-local portfolio staging; hard hold on publication (ask-tier) preserved

explicit: read-only on the source files: do not change them
nothing goes public without his explicit one-tap approval
address him as Marcus Richards, full name
inferred: staging happens in a separate staging area, never in the source tree

deliverable: sorted catalog of the workspace files; best-work triage note; DARPA-standard refinement of the best pick; staged portfolio addition
desired_state: A classified catalog of the workspace, a triaged best-work shortlist, and the top candidate refined to Heilmeier standard and staged — with zero changes to the source files and zero public artifacts.
failure_conditions: if triage cannot separate best from rest, narrow the shortlist rather than promote weakly
kill: no candidate clears the bar — stage nothing
lane_brief: Overnight curation run: catalog the workspace read-only, triage the best work, refine the #1 pick to Heilmeier standard, stage everything. No source writes, no publishing.
objective: Sort and organize the agent workspace files, sort through the best work, and refine the portfolio-worthy picks to DARPA's standard before staging any portfolio addition.

raw.utterance: Work with my agent workspace files here. Sort and organize them all and sort through the best work and if it makes sense to add to the portfolio add it but first refine and edit it to DARPA's standard.

receipt.next: his tap on the publish queue, or corrections
receipt.receipt: CATALOG.md, BEST-OF.md, staged SPEC.md exist at the staged paths

route.reason: multi-step curation ending in an approval gate — the publish tap

in: sort and organize the workspace files
refine the best work to DARPA's standard
add to the portfolio where it makes sense
out: changing files in the source tree

success_conditions: catalog covers the full workspace listing
top candidate refined with the catechism answered in writing
zero writes to the source tree confirmed by re-listing

unknowns.description: what counts as 'best' — his taste vs the curator's

probes: re-list the source workspace and diff against the pre-run listing
verification.readback: Marcus reads the staged SPEC.md and confirms voice and honesty boundary
